detectors.description: Losing either node drops the cluster below its quorum, at which point the cluster filesystem goes read-only and no guest can be started, stopped or migrated.
detectors.name: Quorum margin is zero

detectors.description: A quorum device appears in the membership view and carries no votes, which reads as configured to anything that counts devices rather than votes.
detectors.name: Quorum device configured but contributing nothing

detectors.description: A disabled job is indistinguishable from a job that ran, in every view that lists jobs.
detectors.name: Backup job exists and is disabled

detectors.description: Coverage is the question, not job count: a guest named only by a disabled job has none.
detectors.name: Guest covered by no enabled backup job

detectors.description: A datastore above its threshold, measured against the datastore rather than against any one guest on it.
detectors.name: Datastore near full

detectors.description: A guest at the ceiling of its own volume while its datastore still reads comfortable — the distinction a datastore-level threshold cannot make.
detectors.name: Guest volume near full

detectors.description: Metadata exhaustion takes a pool offline while its data percentage still looks fine.
detectors.name: Thin-pool metadata under pressure

detectors.description: The first real boot of an installed-but-unbooted kernel will be an unplanned one.
detectors.name: Kernel installed and never booted

detectors.description: Losing a node makes its guests unavailable until they are restored from a backup.
detectors.name: No replication with node-local guest storage

detectors.description: Absent from every API level, and where a silent degradation becomes visible.
detectors.name: Failed units on a node

detectors.description: A share that is down still appears in the inventory; only its status says so.
detectors.name: Datastore reporting unknown

detectors.description: Counted separately from the rest, because the rest can wait for a window.
detectors.name: Security updates pending

detectors.description: Everything depends on the bridge and nothing watches it; a rename underneath it took a whole cluster off the network.
detectors.name: A configured bridge does not exist

detectors.description: With two recovery points, the second failed backup destroys what the first left.
detectors.name: Backup retention shallow
